method: Reviewed inscription boundaries; binary ink masks normalized to 24 by 32; bidirectional one pixel tolerant overlap; complete link shape groups at 86 percent. Score is visual affinity, not identity probability. No automatic family or letter acceptance. Comparisons use upright glyph crops only; rotation and reflection are not tested in this module. Rendered reference checks are not independent handwriting accuracy tests.
scope: 106 nonseparator glyph occurrences in six reviewed inscriptions, plus two tablet graphic crops. Faint signatures and background markings remain outside the letter inventory. Historical chart slot boundaries are provisional.

conclusion: One inscription glyph remains unassigned. Two tablet marks remain unclassified graphics. Existing Russian and English readings are annotations from the previous dictionary, not discoveries from this clustering. No additional language, cipher family or book origin is confirmed.
